title: China's first chip equipment quality standard puts supplier reliability in focus
html:
China has issued its first dedicated quality management standard for semiconductor equipment and components, giving fabs and their suppliers a common framework for qualifying parts, auditing vendors and keeping production lines supplied...

Credit: AFP
summary: China has issued its first dedicated quality management standard for semiconductor equipment and components, giving fabs and their suppliers a common framework for qualifying parts, auditing vendors and keeping production lines supplied. The voluntary standard, SJ/T 12425–2026 , was unveiled on Nove
